Direct-drive printed lead screw

Select 40 or 120 mm usable extension. The longer screw and hollow nose keep both threaded bands engaged through the full stroke. Bearing stations remain 74 mm apart. The 40 mm stroke offers 1×, 2× and 4× output widths; 120 mm is 1× only, with a NEMA17 D-shaft motor and integral bolt-and-nut coupling.

One rigid adjustable carrier

The 1× version has two lower bearings; 2× and 4× have four, evenly paired across the two stations. All lower bearings attach to one printed carrier with side rails and cross-braces. Four M5×25 bolts engage M5 heat-set inserts to pull it upward. The bearings press onto split integral axles. The carriage running faces are smooth, without raised side rails to catch small bearing misalignment. All bearing seats retain Ø7.4 mm inner-ring lands and 2 mm outer-ring relief. Solid Ø4.8 mm journals retain the 6.4 mm heads and extended 30° bent tips. Tapered relief cuts have rounded roots; clearance behind the bearing seats frees the prongs. Test snap fit on the actual PETG print.

Structural lid and mounting

The base and lid continue their original 31 mm square grid toward their exit edges, with ribs connecting every insert seat around the cutouts. Cutouts run after all features are complete. One coordinated pattern replaces overlapping floor windows, keeping at least 6 mm between neighboring windows and protecting the motor foot, bearing supports and mounting seats. Their first NEMA17 square is centered 26 mm ahead of the motor. The output plates use the same pitch and retain their centered NEMA17 pattern; the 2× plate is 104 mm wide. Use short M3 heat-set inserts, Ø4.6×4 mm, in Ø4 mm pilots. Lid seats pass through; base seats retain backing where they lie beneath structural feet. Maximum screw entry is 4 mm into the lid or 5 mm into the base. The old side bosses, side holes and external lid mounting holes are removed. Rounded lid windows retain a continuous perimeter and ribs around the mounting and fixing rows. The lid remains 4 mm thick and the assembly stays 68 mm high. Six structural lid fasteners remain separate from the external insert patterns.

Print files

Five printed parts: base with split axles and longer motor braces, pocketed carriage, shared bearing carrier, structural lid and threaded screw. Rounded windows lighten the lid, and cutouts reduce base and carriage volume while retaining the bearing tracks, threaded bands, mounting pads and cross ribs. The fixed bearing-support blocks extend down to the underside of the adjustment-bolt shelves, filling the former 4 mm recess. All parts have individual STL downloads and a source bundle. Geometry checks do not establish load capacity, backlash or print-fit tolerances.

Geometry checks

Loading check report…

Hardware meshes are fit references. Carrier adjustment shows rigid take-up to contact, not preload force. The viewer and STL retain the same split head geometry. Undeformed head/bore interference is recorded in the assembly report. Insertion force and deformation are not simulated. Test bearing fit, insertion force, retention and creep before use.

Detailed geometry report

Repeating NEMA17 mounting grid

The output plate, lid and base use a uniform 31 mm square hole grid. The 2× output plate is now 104 mm wide so it keeps a centered NEMA17 square. Both faces keep the same origin and continue in 31 mm steps toward the exit. The 120 mm printed-screw version has eight base rows and seven lid rows; the 300 mm T8 has eleven rows on each. Shorter designs retain five rows.

To mount a wider plate along a narrow host’s length, center a 2× plate at 57 or 88 mm ahead of the motor and use all eight holes. A 4× plate uses the same two positions and ten of its twelve holes; the remaining outer pair overhangs the original five-row grid. Longer bases and lids also include the forward outer pair. Wide actuator variants are offered only for the 40 mm printed-screw stroke. Bearing positions are unchanged.

Print files & source

Downloads match the selected travel length and width. The bundle contains all printed-part STLs, CAD source, configuration and check report. No STEP download is required.
